name: slop-editor
description: A slop editor: track who wrote every word on a page (the AI, you, or nobody), then read the slop and make it yours.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const {version:v}=require('./package.json'),{version:w}=require('./.claude-plugin/plugin.json');if(v!==w){console.error('package.json says '+v+' but .claude-plugin/plugin.json says '+w+': make them match');process.exit(1)}const o=JSON.parse(require('child_process').execFileSync('npm',['view','slop-editor','versions','--json'],{encoding:'utf8'}));if(o.includes(v)){console.error('slop-editor '+v+' is already on npm ('+o.at(-1)+' is the latest): bump the version in package.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json first');process.exit(1)}"

author: Raphael Bajet
